tools.name: trackrev_me
tools.description:
Which workspace, plan, limits and key you're using.

Read-only.

Equivalent CLI: trackrev me

instructions:
TrackRev tracks marketing links, attributes revenue to the channel that earned it, and runs affiliate programs.

Tools are named after the CLI they run: trackrev_links_create is `trackrev links create`.
Analytics, affiliate and money tools need a paid plan and fail with plan_required otherwise.
Tools marked DESTRUCTIVE take a `confirm` boolean that must be true; pass it only on an explicit instruction from the person, never to retry a call that failed for some other reason.
Money and partner tools do not send the emails the dashboard sends, so running one twice does not mail anyone twice — but it does change the ledger twice.
